description: Models, reusable profiles and service connections — kept distinct.
unknownHelp: No capability evidence is available for this model. An endpoint alone does not establish compatibility.
fixtureMetadata: Illustrative metadata; not verified against a service.
profileHelp: Profiles express reusable intent. Changing a profile will require impact review before application in a later phase.
assignmentHelp: Agent Detail is the model assignment entry point. This preview does not change assignments.
chainNote: A dotted link is a step this Agent does not use. A connected Provider never makes an Agent ready by itself.
profileHelpLive: A profile is reusable intent. Saving a new revision never rewrites Agents; each Agent applies it through its own confirmed plan.
identifierHelp: Exact provider-native identifier, e.g. what the Agent's docs list.
manualUnknown: Manual models keep unknown capabilities. Nexus does not test availability.
profileKicker: Each save is a new revision
profileTargetHelp: Pick an existing profile to create its next revision.
profileRevised: New revision saved. Applied Agents keep their pinned revision until you apply again.
baseUrlHelp: HTTPS, or http://localhost for a local server.
envVarHelp: Nexus records the name only, never the value.
customProviderLimit: No supported Agent can receive a Nexus-stored key without writing it in plain text, so custom endpoints cannot be assigned to Agents yet.
compat.providerNotRoutable: This Agent does not route to that Provider.
compat.customProviderHandoff: Custom Providers need a secret handoff Nexus does not perform.
compat.availabilityUnverified: Availability of this model to your account is not verified.
compat.noModelTarget: This Agent has no supported model setting.
